transactions.citation: full.md line 4470 (Note 11 Assets Held For Sale): 'On 8 May 2024, the Stapled Group entered into conditional purchase and sale agreements with a purchaser to sell Hyatt House Philadelphia Plymouth Meeting, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania ("HHPM") and Hyatt House Shelton, Connecticut ("HHS") for a total consideration of US$31.0 million.
